description: Turn a flag on or off in one environment, by flag key and environment key. When turning a flag on, rolloutPercent says who gets it: 100 for everyone, or a percentage of users. Ask the user whether it should be on for everyone. Without rolloutPercent it's 0, which turns it on only for the environment's testers. Changing production needs confirmProduction: true. Only send that after the user has confirmed the change.
name: set_flag
title: Turn a flag on or off
